title: Monotonicity of step counts
statement: Let $w$ be a natural number and let $E$ be a relation on Boolean strings that is reflexive, meaning $E(B,B)$ for every string $B$. If $k\le k'$, $B$ has length $w$, and there is a $k$-step chain from $A$ to $B$, then there is a $k'$-step chain from $A$ to $B$.
hypotheses_covered: There is a $k$-step chain from $A$ to $B$
